affixes.name: Valor
affixes.description: Increases Attack. Upon reaching a certain level, also increases Defense Penetration.

levels.5: Attack +7.5%. Defense Penetration +1.8%.

affixes.name: Eloquence
affixes.description: Increases Chanting Speed. Upon reaching a certain level, chanting cannot be interrupted by minor Impact. Cooldown: 15s.

levels.5: Chanting Speed +15%. Chanting cannot be interrupted by minor impacts.
levels.6: Chanting Speed +18%. Chanting cannot be interrupted by minor impacts.
levels.7: Chanting Speed +21%. Chanting cannot be interrupted by minor impacts.

affixes.name: Stoic
affixes.description: When Health is below 50%, increase Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance. Upon reaching a certain level, when Health is below 30%, restore Health. Cooldown: 120s.

levels.5: Physical Resistance +5.5%. Magic Resistance +5.5%. Restores 15% Health.
levels.6: Physical Resistance +6.6%. Magic Resistance +6.6%. Restores 15% Health.
levels.7: Physical Resistance +7.7%. Magic Resistance +7.7%. Restores 15% Health.

affixes.name: Ranged
affixes.description: If the distance between you and the target is greater than 5 meters when hit, temporarily increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, increase ranged damage's effective range. Effective Range: Different ranged attacks have different Effective Ranges. Beyond the Effective Range, both DMG and Impact will diminish.

levels.5: Physical Damage +8%. Magic Damage +8%. Effective Range +12%.
levels.6: Physical Damage +9.6%. Magic Damage +9.6%. Effective Range +12%.
levels.7: Physical Damage +11.2%. Magic Damage +11.2%. Effective Range +12%.

affixes.name: Unyielding
affixes.description: Each time you take damage from a different enemy, you gain Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance for 6s. Entering combat refreshes this duration. Stacks up to 2 times. Upon reaching a certain level, the maximum stacks increase to 4.

levels.5: Physical Resistance +3.5%. Magic Resistance +3.5%. Stacks up to 4 times.
levels.6: Physical Resistance +4.2%. Magic Resistance +4.2%. Stacks up to 4 times.
levels.7: Physical Resistance +4.9%. Magic Resistance +4.9%. Stacks up to 4 times.

affixes.name: Seamless
affixes.description: Increases Skill Cooldown Speed. Upon reaching a certain level, knocking down a Gyldhunter reduces skill cooldowns currently in progress.

levels.5: Skill Cooldown Speed +11%. Gyldhunter Knockdown Cooldown Refund +30%.
levels.6: Skill Cooldown Speed +13.2%. Gyldhunter Knockdown Cooldown Refund +30%.
levels.7: Skill Cooldown Speed +15.4%. Gyldhunter Knockdown Cooldown Refund +30%.

affixes.name: Resilience
affixes.description: Reduces the duration of debuffs received. Upon reaching a certain level, suffering a crowd control debuff temporarily increases your Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance. Crowd Control Debuffs: Crowd control debuffs include Stunned, Frozen, Immobilize, and Dodge Distance Reduction.

levels.4: Debuff Duration -20%. Physical Resistance +10%. Magic Resistance +10%.
levels.5: Debuff Duration -25%. Physical Resistance +10%. Magic Resistance +10%.

affixes.name: Aegis
affixes.description: Increase Defense. Upon reaching a certain level, increase Physical Resistance.

levels.5: Defense +75. Physical Resistance +2.5%.

affixes.name: Seeker
affixes.description: Hitting an enemy increases Movement Speed for 3s. Upon reaching a certain level, the Speed Boost can stack.

levels.4: Movement Speed +4.5%, stacking up to 2 times.
levels.5: Movement Speed +6%, stacking up to 2 times.

affixes.name: Sky Piercer
affixes.description: Casting skills in the air increases Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, aerial casting also reduces Skill Energy Cost.

levels.5: Physical Damage +8%. Magic Damage +8%. Skill Energy Cost Reduction +8%.
levels.6: Physical Damage +9.6%. Magic Damage +9.6%. Skill Energy Cost Reduction +8%.
levels.7: Physical Damage +11.2%. Magic Damage +11.2%. Skill Energy Cost Reduction +8%.

affixes.name: Fervor
affixes.description: After hitting an enemy, increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage for 3s, stacking up to 5 times. Upon reaching the required level, when the number of stacks is greater than or equal to 3, increase Defense Penetration.

levels.5: Physical Damage +2%. Magic Damage +2%. Defense Penetration +2.5%.
levels.6: Physical Damage +2.4%. Magic Damage +2.4%. Defense Penetration +2.5%.
levels.7: Physical Damage +2.8%. Magic Damage +2.8%. Defense Penetration +2.5%.

affixes.name: Strife
affixes.description: Increases Melee Weapon Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, increases Melee Weapon Damage for each nearby enemy, up to 3 stacks.

levels.5: Physical Damage +6%. Magic Damage +6%. Physical Damage per stack +2%. Magic Damage per stack +2%.
levels.6: Physical Damage +7.2%. Magic Damage +7.2%. Physical Damage per stack +2%. Magic Damage per stack +2%.
levels.7: Physical Damage +8.4%. Magic Damage +8.4%. Physical Damage per stack +2%. Magic Damage per stack +2%.

affixes.name: Fervid
affixes.description: When Health is above 70%, increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, when Health is above 70%, reduce Skill Energy Cost.

levels.5: Physical Damage +9%. Magic Damage +9%. Skill Energy Cost Reduction +6%.
levels.6: Physical Damage +10.8%. Magic Damage +10.8%. Skill Energy Cost Reduction +6%.
levels.7: Physical Damage +12.6%. Magic Damage +12.6%. Skill Energy Cost Reduction +6%.

affixes.name: Vitality
affixes.description: Increases Maximum Energy. Upon reaching a certain level, when entering a state of Energy Overdraft, you become immune to that specific instance of Energy Overdraft. Cooldown: 60s.

levels.4: Maximum Energy +20. Immune to the current Energy Overdraft state.
levels.5: Maximum Energy +25. Immune to the current Energy Overdraft state.

affixes.name: Elusive
affixes.description: Reduces Dodge Energy Cost.

levels.5: Dodge Energy Cost Reduction +20%.

affixes.name: Wrath
affixes.description: When Health is below 50%, increase Physical Damage and Magic Damage. Upon reaching a certain level, when Health is below 50%, increase Attack.

levels.5: Physical Damage +10.5%. Magic Damage +10.5%. Attack +3%.

affixes.name: Tenacious
affixes.description: Increases Maximum Health. Upon reaching a certain level, increases Healing.

levels.5: Maximum Health +9%. Healing +7.5%.

affixes.name: Iron Helmet
affixes.description: Increase Critical Damage Resistance. Upon reaching the required level, reduce the impact of Critical Hits received. Critical Hit: Hitting weak points deals Critical Hits, increasing DMG based on Critical DMG while enhancing Impact. The head is a weak point for both Gyldhunters and most monsters.

levels.4: Critical Damage Resistance +8.8%. Reduces the Impact of Critical Hits received.
levels.5: Critical Damage Resistance +11%. Reduces the Impact of Critical Hits received.

affixes.name: Distant Ward
affixes.description: If the distance between you and the attacker is greater than 5 meters when hit, temporarily increases your Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance. Upon reaching a certain level, you also resist minor impacts from distances greater than 5 meters; once triggered, this effect has a cooldown of 10s.

levels.5: Physical Resistance +8%. Magic Resistance +8%. Resists minor impacts from sources beyond 5 meters.
levels.6: Physical Resistance +9.6%. Magic Resistance +9.6%. Resists minor impacts from sources beyond 5 meters.
levels.7: Physical Resistance +11.2%. Magic Resistance +11.2%. Resists minor impacts from sources beyond 5 meters.

affixes.name: Curse
affixes.description: Increase the duration of Debuffs inflicted by you.

levels.5: Debuff Duration +25%.

affixes.name: Focused
affixes.description: Increases Charging Speed. Upon reaching a certain level, increases Movement Speed while charging.

levels.5: Charging Speed +15%. Movement Speed +10%.

affixes.name: Blessing
affixes.description: Increase the duration of Buffs granted by you.

levels.5: Buff Duration +25%.

affixes.name: Bulwark
affixes.description: Increase Block Damage Reduction Rate. Upon reaching the required level, reduce Block Energy Cost.

levels.4: Block Damage Reduction Rate +24%. Block Energy Cost Reduction +9%.
levels.5: Block Damage Reduction Rate +30%. Block Energy Cost Reduction +9%.

affixes.name: Burst
affixes.description: Increases the damage of Withered Knight's Wither Execution.

levels.5: Execution Damage +25%.

affixes.name: Creation
affixes.description: Increases the duration of Constructs. Upon reaching a certain level, successfully summoning a Construct increases Physical Damage and Magic Damage for a period of time. Constructs: Objects generated by players that have a limited lifespan and can be destroyed are collectively referred to as Constructs, such as: the Seer's Rune Pillar, Frostbite Trap, Eye of True Sight, mushroom traps from Spore Arrow, Forbidden Gate, etc.

levels.5: Construct Duration +20%. Physical Damage +5%. Magic Damage +5%.
levels.6: Construct Duration +24%. Physical Damage +5%. Magic Damage +5%.
levels.7: Construct Duration +28%. Physical Damage +5%. Magic Damage +5%.

affixes.name: Wealth
affixes.description: Increase the amount of Gyldenblod from PvE in dungeons.

levels.5: Amount of Gyldenblod dropped +50%.

affixes.name: Deft
affixes.description: Increases Interaction Speed. Interactions cannot be interrupted by minor Impacts; once triggered, this effect has a cooldown of 10s.

levels.4: Interaction Speed +24%. Interactions cannot be interrupted by minor impacts.
levels.5: Interaction Speed +30%. Interactions cannot be interrupted by minor impacts.

affixes.name: Swift
affixes.description: Increases Movement Speed while Crouching, Silent-Walking, Aiming and Chanting.

levels.5: Movement Speed +20%.

affixes.name: Spirit Shield
affixes.description: Increases shield strength. Upon reaching a certain level, the shields you apply grant Magic Resistance to shielded units while active.

levels.5: Shield Strength +12%. Magic Resistance +5%.

affixes.name: Brotherhood
affixes.description: While alive, grants increased Defense to yourself and allies. If multiple team members have this affix, only the highest-level affix takes effect. Upon reaching a certain level, grants increased Attack to yourself and allies.

levels.5: Defense +30. Attack +1.8%.

affixes.name: Ethereal
affixes.description: Increase Fall Damage Resistance. Upon reaching the required level, falling no longer causes stagger.

levels.4: Fall Damage Resistance +80%. Falling no longer staggers you.
levels.5: Fall Damage Resistance +100%. Falling no longer staggers you.

affixes.name: Smiting
affixes.description: On a Critical Hit, recover Energy. Cooldown: 3s. Upon reaching a certain level, on a Critical Hit, reduce the cooldown of all skills. Cooldown: 3s. Critical Hit: Hitting weak points deals Critical Hits, increasing DMG based on Critical DMG while enhancing Impact. The head is a weak point for both Gyldhunters and most monsters.

levels.4: Recovers Energy by 8. Reduces Cooldown by 1s.
levels.5: Recovers Energy by 10. Reduces Cooldown by 1s.
